frame.mapping: x = KiCadX - originX; y = originY - KiCadY; z = height above nominal PCB top
frame.transform_status: KiCad 10 bottom-datum convention; validate imported bounds and component placement for each package
frame.note: STEP/GLB substrate can exclude copper/mask thickness. Board mechanical envelope uses nominal full thickness; preserve actual export offset.

board.outline_approximation: Native KiCad polygonization; curved edges are tessellated. Keep margins above tessellation uncertainty.

limitations: Envelope fit checks do not validate electrical safety, thermal performance, EMC, cable flex, or manufacturing tolerances not explicitly specified.
H-numbered footprints define mounting-hole candidates; other NPTH pads are not automatically mounting holes.
